outcome: bleeding >1000 ml in connection with Caesarean delivery
cohort: The study comprised a cohort of 1,253 women enrolled in the national prenatal healthcare program in Sweden between 2012 and 2013.
finding: Multiple ACEs were associated with higher rates of adverse perinatal outcomes, with the strongest associations found for women with 4 or more ACE categories.
mod_finding: Women with 4 or more ACE categories had an increased adjusted odds ratio of 2.02 for emergency Caesarean delivery.
